MathTrail

Connect Claude to MathTrail?

After you sign in, you will be sent back to claude.ai/api/mcp/auth_callback.

Google will then ask you to sign in and to let MathTrail keep one file of its own in your Google Drive, where your child's progress is saved. MathTrail sees no other file there.

By allowing, you accept MathTrail's terms of use and privacy policy.

Reviewing MathTrail for a directory?

Sign in with the reviewer's password from the review form, in place of Google. It opens the demo profile kept for review.
